title: Factorization of the pre-quotient wedge map
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $0\to A\xrightarrow{f}B\xrightarrow{g}C\to0$ a short exact sequence of module sheaves. Let $r_1,r_2,r_3\in\mathbb N$, $r_2=r_1+r_3$, with $A$ finite locally free of rank $r_1$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Write $T=(\bigwedge^{r_1}A)\otimes(\bigwedge^{r_3}B)$ and $Q=(\bigwedge^{r_1}A)\otimes(\bigwedge^{r_3}C)$ using [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. Suppose morphisms $q:T\to Q$ and $\psi:T\to\bigwedge^{r_2}B$ are given. For every open $U$ and tuples $a\in A(U)^{r_1}$, $c\in B(U)^{r_3}$ suppose $q_U((\bigwedge a_i)\otimes(\bigwedge c_j))=(\bigwedge a_i)\otimes(\bigwedge g_U(c_j))$ and $\psi_U((\bigwedge a_i)\otimes(\bigwedge c_j))=\bigwedge(f_U(a_1),\ldots,f_U(a_{r_1}),c_1,\ldots,c_{r_3})$. Then there is $\varphi:Q\to\bigwedge^{r_2}B$ with $\varphi\circ q=\psi$.

proof.text: Short exactness makes S.g epi. Apply the official exteriorTensor_quotient_exists to obtain an epimorphic exterior tensor quotient with its pure-wedge formula.
Apply exteriorTensor_lift_hom_ext with the identity on S.X2 to compare q with the quotient on pure wedge tensors; transport the Epi instance along their equality.

Apply exteriorTensor_kernel_eq_zero_of_relations to q and psi. The psi formula reduces each relation to a full-rank wedge containing one additional S.f image, which exteriorSheaf_rank_wedge_eq_zero kills. This gives kernel.ι q followed by psi equal to zero.
Use Abelian.epiDesc to descend psi through q and comp_epiDesc to obtain the factorization equation.

theorem determinant_wedge_quotient_factor {X : Scheme.{v}}
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) (r₁ r₂ r₃ : ℕ)
    (hr : r₂ = r₁ + r₃) [S.X₁.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₁]
    (q : exteriorPower S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorPower S.X₂ r₃ ⟶
      exteriorPower S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorPower S.X₃ r₃)
    (ψ : exteriorPower S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorPower S.X₂ r₃ ⟶ exteriorPower S.X₂ r₂)
    (hq : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U))
      (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)),
      q.val.app (op U)
        (tmulSection (wedge (M := S.X₁) (r := r₁) (U := U) a)
          (wedge (M := S.X₂) (r := r₃) (U := U) c)) =
        tmulSection (M := exteriorPower S.X₁ r₁)
          (N := exteriorPower S.X₃ r₃) (U := U)
          (wedge (M := S.X₁) (r := r₁) (U := U) a)
          (wedge (M := S.X₃) (r := r₃) (U := U) (fun i ↦ S.g.val.app (op U) (c i))))
    (hψ : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U))
      (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)),
      ψ.val.app (op U)
        (tmulSection (wedge (M := S.X₁) (r := r₁) (U := U) a)
          (wedge (M := S.X₂) (r := r₃) (U := U) c)) =
        wedge (M := S.X₂) (r := r₂) (U := U)
          (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op U) (a j)) c (Fin.cast hr i))) :
    ∃ φ : exteriorPower S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorPower S.X₃ r₃ ⟶ exteriorPower S.X₂ r₂,
      q ≫ φ = ψ
